title: From serious customs offences to alleged misstatements: Expanding grounds for denial of AEO status beyond the Board’s guidelines
description: The Customs administrations worldwide face the dual responsibility of preventing unlawful trade while facilitating legitimate trade. To strengthen supply chain security and facilitate international trade, the World Customs Organization (WCO) adopted the SAFE Framework of Standards in 2005. In furtherance of this objective, several countries have implemented trusted trader programmes, such as the Customs Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) in the United States, the Partners in Protection
